summary: The target lacks essential DNS records to prevent email spoofing and enforce email authentication, which could allow attackers to spoof emails from the domain. No open ports were found, so no active scanning was performed.

findings.title: Missing SPF DNS Record
findings.why_it_matters: An SPF record helps prevent email spoofing by specifying which mail servers are permitted to send emails on behalf of your domain. Without it, attackers can send emails that appear to come from your domain.
findings.suggested_action:
Add an SPF record to your DNS configuration. Example:

`v=spf1 a mx ~all`

findings.title: Missing DMARC DNS Record
findings.why_it_matters: A DMARC record helps enforce email authentication policies by specifying how to handle emails that fail SPF or DKIM checks. Without it, attackers can send emails that appear to come from your domain without any policy enforcement.
findings.suggested_action:
Add a DMARC record to your DNS configuration. Example:

`v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto@example.com`
